extracted.name: Lauren's Autumn Harvest Soup
extracted.description: Great recipe for Lauren's Autumn Harvest Soup.
ingredient_lines: 1 zucchini cut in half or fourths
1 squash cut in half or fourths
2-3 cups water (make sure all the veggies are covered)
instruction_lines: Boil noodles till adente or slightly done.
Chop all veggies and drain your veggies that are canned EXCEPT for tomatoes!
Add olive oil and Sauté garlic in pot until fragrant.
Add your chicken broth and beef broth to garlic.
Add all veggies, tomatoes and tomato paste.
Add kielbasa sausage and stir til combined. On medium high continue to cook. (((Remember let it sit for a few so all the spices can render together.)))
